others.title: PlayStation 为何抛弃小岛秀夫？分析师称索尼可能因《死亡搁浅 2》的销量而“受到惊吓”

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260911/FInNvGbucgllpaw.png
随着 PlayStation 宣布放弃 Physint —— 这款由传奇的 METAL GEAR SOLID Δ: SNAKE EATER 创作者小岛秀夫开发的、听起来极具野心的次世代项目 —— 尘埃落定，分析师们现在正在讨论索尼为何选择退出。
当然，Physint 将继续开发 —— 只是现在由 PlayStation 的宿敌 Xbox 支持，这对于微软游戏部门来说是一次重大且急需的公关胜利。
与此同时，索尼被视为在又一个重大公开时刻上出尔反尔 —— 这一次是 PlayStation Studios 负责人 Herman Hulst 与小岛秀夫之间曾预示 Physint 公布的热情握手 —— 尽管粉丝们对 PlayStation 淘汰光驱的举措怨声载道，且对 宿星的女朋友2 ―destiny star girlfriend― 开发裁撤感到不安。
为什么要冒着进一步遭到抵制的风险？日本游戏产业咨询公司 Kantan Games 的首席执行官 Serkan Toto 博士认为，小岛秀夫最近的作品 死亡搁浅2 的销量可能是罪魁祸首。

“小岛秀夫的游戏具有强大的平台营销光环效应，不仅仅关乎销量，但似乎从 死亡搁浅2 1 到 死亡搁浅2 的剧烈下滑足以让索尼感到不安并切断合作，”Toto 今天早上在社交媒体上写道。
死亡搁浅2 1 和 死亡搁浅2 之间的直接对比很困难，因为索尼或小岛工作室从未公布后者的官方销量。“这当然不是一个好兆头，”Toto 指出。
今天，来自 Alinea Analytics 的最新销量估算显示 死亡搁浅2 的销量为 250 万份。这与体验过原版 死亡搁浅2 的玩家人数（约 2000 万）相去甚远，但这里存在一些限制条件。
以下是我们确切知道的：截至 2021 年 3 月，死亡搁浅2 1 已售出 500 万份；截至 2025 年 3 月，拥有 2000 万名玩家 —— 这一数字包括通过 Xbox Game Pass 等订阅服务访问游戏，或通过 Epic Game Store 促销活动免费领取游戏的玩家。今年 7 月，小岛工作室声明 死亡搁浅2 系列两部游戏的累计玩家人数已达到 2700 万。
同样来自 Alinea 的销量分析表明，死亡搁浅2 的销量现在已放缓至涓涓细流，该游戏的几次显著折扣未能扭转局面，且该游戏的收入仍低于其前作。
这里呈现出的画面是，续作未能巩固甚至未能达到 死亡搁浅2 1 所建立的销量和影响力。正如 Toto 所言，这或许足以“吓到”索尼，尤其是这两个项目都被视为奢华制作，拥有漫长的开发周期，并由好莱坞明星担任关键角色。
展望 Physint，索尼可能觉得资助类似制作规模和时长所需的投入根本不划算 —— 尤其是 Physint 看起来更加宏大，涉及的名演员也更多。去年，小岛估计该游戏距离完成还有 5 到 6 年的时间，并且有传言称还涉及某种形式的电影制作。
所有这些问题现在都将由微软来解决，不过正如 Toto 所指出的，所涉及的财务成本将在一定程度上被这一消息对 Xbox 品牌的积极影响所抵消，尤其是在经历了一个夏天的裁员、工作室关闭以及为了专注于更有可能产生影响的游戏而取消的一系列项目之后。虽然 Physint 可能还需要五年时间，但它现在是 Xbox 下一代 Project Helix 的招牌作品（且可能是主机独占）。
“对于核心玩家来说，这对 PlayStation 来说并不是什么好事，”Alinea Analytics 分析师 Rhys Elliot 今天指出。“尤其是现在。不过，从纯粹的财务角度来看，我可以理解索尼的立场。至少在孤立的情况下是这样。”
“粗略计算：传闻第一部 死亡搁浅2 的制作成本约为 1 亿美元，第二部在 1.5 亿至 2 亿美元之间（更长的开发周期、疫情等因素），”他继续说道。“考虑到营销开支以及将 Guerrilla 的开发者抽调至 死亡搁浅2 1 的机会成本，该系列几乎肯定已经盈亏平衡 —— 但盈利并不多。”

“利润率是现在的关键，”Elliot 补充道，他认为 PlayStation Studios 最近的几次重大失利使得公司在支持大预算项目时变得更加谨慎。“在过去的几年里，像 Concord（已取消，3 亿美元以上付诸东流）这样的惊吓，以及 马拉松The Messenger from Athens at Marathon（销量 180 万）、Saros（6100 万美元）、Marvel Tokon（72.5 万份，4900 万美元）和 乐高：地平线冒险（Steam 和 PS5 平台合计不足 25 万份，1100 万美元）等作品的销量疲软，似乎让 PlayStation 变得更加警觉。”

items.title: 《纸间谜迹 Paper Trail》主创表示，如果《The Office》是披头士乐队，那么这部衍生作就是 Wings 乐队。

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260911/xJYFDHbucgllodA.png
纸间谜迹 Paper Trail Season 2 现已在 Peacock 平台开播。

在 纸间谜迹 Paper Trail Season 2 中，这部以俄亥俄州托莱多为背景的美国版 The Office 衍生剧，开始摆脱 Dunder Mifflin 的影子。尽管两部剧集之间仍有相似之处（Oscar 依然在那里，评判着每一个荒唐的计划和社交失礼），但 纸间谜迹 Paper Trail 的新剧集表明，这部剧正努力走出自己的风格。剧中暧昧的关系开始升温，办公室八卦变得更加辛辣，虚构的纪录片摄制组也尝试了一些新花样。
在 纸间谜迹 Paper Trail Season 2 首播前，我与剧集共同创作人兼执行制片人 Greg Daniels（曾参与《山丘之王》、《公园与游憩》）和 Michael Koman（曾参与《内森翻拍秀》）进行了一次独家专访。他们解析了剧中的一些关键时刻，并透露了为了让 纸间谜迹 Paper Trail 超越 The Office 的框架而做出的一系列深思熟虑的决定。
Ned 和 Mare 与 The Office 的 Jim 和 Pam 有何“不同”

从 纸间谜迹 Paper Trail Season 2 一开始，主角 Ned（《托莱多真相报》总编，由 Domhnall Gleeson 饰演）和 Mare（Ned 的得力助手兼明星记者，由 Chelsea Frei 饰演）就迅速推进了自 纸间谜迹 Paper Trail Season 1 以来一直萌动的恋情。Daniels 和 Koman 表示，虽然不可避免地会被拿来与 The Office 中的 Jim 和 Pam 作比较，但 纸间谜迹 Paper Trail 较短的季长度意味着一切都被压缩了。
：本季的核心是 Ned 和 Mare 之间的关系。我想很多人会说：“哦，他们就是 纸间谜迹 Paper Trail 里的 Jim 和 Pam。”但你们很大程度上跳过了 Jim 和 Pam 经历了好几季的那种渴望和思念。为什么决定在这部剧中如此迅速地推进这段核心关系？
Greg Daniels： 嗯，你永远不想重复之前做过的内容。首先，他们是截然不同的角色。其次，我认为剧集的类型也不同。这是每年一次性释出的 10 集内容。我们更倾向于把它看作系列丛书中的一册，而不是每周更新、长达一年的连载故事。所以对于这段关系，这算是我们的“第二本书”。我认为指望能有 100 集来讲述这个故事可能不太现实，所以我们加快了节奏。
关于“坏好事”的对话
由于 纸间谜迹 Paper Trail 是在流媒体平台而非线性电视网播出，Daniels 和 Koman 都表示，他们在创作更贴近现实办公室谈话的对话时感到更加自由。虽然结果往往很幽默，但其背后的逻辑其实更深层，本季中期 Oscar (Oscar Nuñez 饰) 和 Detrick (Melvin Gregg 饰) 讨论 Oscar 潜在约会对象的一场戏就证明了这一点。
：我不会觉得这部剧很出格，但你们在这一批新剧集中确实把尺度推得更远了一些。里面有一些脏话和低俗幽默。这是在流媒体播出而非有线电视的优势之一吗？
Michael Koman： 嗯，你仍然必须遵守某些规则，因为会有分级。所以你尽量不要滑向 TV-MA（成人级）。这是一部我们希望全家人都能观看的剧集。但是你希望剧集听起来真实。所以在某种程度上，当语言过于净化时，它听起来就不再真实了。
电视和流媒体的感觉是不同的。所以我确实觉得应该稍微突破一下。我认为这更多是一种直觉，而不是某种理性的思考。只是觉得，“也许我们可以让这段对话听起来更接近我们真实的说话方式。”
Daniels： 你指的可能就是关于“坏好事”（cock block）的那段对话。
Koman： Oscar 和 Detrick 当时在进行一段关于“坏好事”的重要对话。但对我来说，Oscar 实际上是在谈论安全性行为。在某种程度上，给一段一个人实际上在倡导安全性行为的对话打码是不对的，无论他们使用了什么样的语言，因为他们所说的话实际上对人们是有益的。
如果 The Office 是披头士，那么 纸间谜迹 Paper Trail 就是 Wings 乐队
虽然这部剧与 The Office 共享一个虚构宇宙，但 Daniels 和 Korman 表示，目前轮换的角色决定了正在进行的情节线，而不是盲目遵循前作。
：这部剧依然存在于 The Office 的世界中。第一季中有一些明显的联动。到了 纸间谜迹 Paper Trail Season 2，要进一步将其与前作区分开来是否更具挑战性？
Daniels： 你是为你拥有的演员阵容和你创造的角色而写的，你几乎可以忘记 Oscar 曾在另一部剧里出现过。我真的不觉得我们考虑原版太多，除非有人提出了一个有趣的创意，而我们意识到它与原版中已经发生过的事情太接近了。但我真的不觉得连接这两个世界有巨大的压力。
Koman： 我想说，我们最不愿做的事就是刻意制造联系，让我们剧中的某个角色去做任何旨在呼应另一部剧的事情。我认为，如果非要说的话，这就是披头士和 Wings 乐队的关系。是的，偶尔有些东西听起来会像披头士。
新角色搅动新闻编辑室
随着《托莱多真相报》核心员工的磨合，本季有几个新面孔加入，为正在进行的情节线带来了变数。新任人力资源主管 Lisa（Lisa Gilroy 饰）一出场就引起了极其不当的麻烦。同样，Mare 的新同事 Todd（Jon Lovitz 饰）也带着浓厚的愤世嫉俗气息闯入了 纸间谜迹 Paper Trail。
：本季我们看到了 Lisa Gilroy 的加入，她饰演一位言辞犀利、甚至有些冒犯的人力资源代表。为什么决定把这个角色引入这个世界？

Koman： 我们在季初构思这个角色时，想的是一个非常年轻的人，大约 19 岁左右。这是我们当时对这个角色的全部想法，她在负责人力资源，而且举止不当，几乎是因为无知。后来当 Lisa 出现时，感觉就是，“哦，那她是演这个角色的最佳人选。”对于一个两分钟的场景，她能给你提供半小时的表演方案。我一直认为 Fred Willard 和 Catherine O'Hara 是即兴表演的巅峰。对我来说，她就是那样的水平。
：Jon Lovitz 是本季的重要组成部分。你们当时是想让他来演这个角色吗？是为他量身定做的吗？

Daniels： 我曾和他一起在《周六夜现场》共事，我认为他是一位了不起的演员。他在《红粉联盟》中的表现太棒了。我们当时在想新闻编辑室里会出现的哪些其他类型的记者。我们想到了一个非常消极的人，那种像“屹耳”一样的记者。我们在剧本里把它写成了“Jon Lovitz 类型”的角色。然后我们想，“等等，也许我们真的可以请 Jon Lovitz 来演这个 Jon Lovitz 类型的角色！他演 Jon Lovitz 类型肯定很棒！”他确实完成得非常出色。太让人满意了。
Esmeralda 的背景故事，既荒诞又悲惨
虽然 纸间谜迹 Paper Trail Season 2 中新角色层出不穷，但 Daniels 和 Koman 保证，一些关于核心角色的长期疑问确实会有答案。例如 Esmeralda，她是《真相报》那位自恋、活泼、非常有意大利风情的执行主编，由 Sabrina Impacciatore 饰演。
：为什么 Esmeralda 会在托莱多？我们会找到答案吗？你们会有专门的一集来讲述她的背景故事吗？
Daniels： 我们正在讨论深入挖掘她的背景故事。我们正在商量怎么处理她的戏份。但我们的设定是，她原本在意大利的一个小镇。一个美国人出现了，让她神魂颠倒，承诺给她在美国过上极其显赫的生活。她离开小镇时基本上带着一种“再见了，傻瓜们”的态度。然后——
Koman： 她烧掉了在意大利所有的退路。没有回头路了。
Daniels： 没法回去了。然后那个男人丢下她和一个孩子跑了，现在她是一个单身母亲，回不了家，在 Ned 出现之前，她已经为自己创造了相当不错的生活。
龙卷风与机器人入侵 纸间谜迹 Paper Trail
Daniels 和 Koman 还刻意尝试让 纸间谜迹 Paper Trail Season 2 的场面变得更大。关键时刻包括一场袭击托莱多的龙卷风，导致记者 Travis (Eric Rahill 饰) 和 Adelola (Gbemisola Ikumelo 饰) 在路边的水沟里寻求庇护；以及 Mare 和 Ned 一起度过周末，却被安装在机器人送餐车上的摄像头打断。
：也许整季最宏大的场景就是水沟里躲避龙卷风的那场戏。
Daniels： 我就知道你会这么说！我们非常喜欢那场戏。我们极力保留了它。太好笑了。那是做“龙卷风集”的部分原因。
Koman： 最终，那个画面真的让我们大笑，我们想看到它。我认为当你制作这种类型的剧集时，有时候你会看着投入其中的资源，心里想我真的希望这值得。那里用到了起重机和滑轮。但对我个人而言，我觉得每一分钱都花得值。
：在另一个极端是送餐车摄像头。为了把它加入剧情，你们必须很有创意。
Daniels： 在那一集中，纪录片制片人在道德上有点瑕疵，因为他在偷窥他们的酒店房间。所以我们和平台方在这个问题上进行了很多反复讨论，因为他们担心我们会把制片人塑造成一个变态。我们对摄像机的规则非常严格。我认为有一件事总是困扰着我，就是在所谓的伪纪录片中，当卧室里有场景时，你会想，“好吧，等等。他们真的会在摄影师在场的情况下那样做吗？”所以我们尝试考虑到这一点，并引出了一些有趣的事情。
：我期待 纸间谜迹 Paper Trail Season 3 中你们用 Flock 摄像头进行记录。
Koman： 我们正在讨论。这个提议确实出现过！
Daniels： Flock 摄像头、行车记录仪。到处都有很多摄像头。
欲了解更多关于 纸间谜迹 Paper Trail 的信息，请阅读我们的 纸间谜迹 Paper Trail Season 2 评论，了解为什么我们说这部剧继续是一部令人耳目一新的喜剧，也是 The Office 值得关注的继任者。

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260911/kuPaWJbucgllkjF.png
我使用折叠屏手机已经很多年了，每天都随身携带三星 Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra。虽然这款手机在日常使用的大部分场景下都表现出色，但在游戏体验方面却一直不尽如人意。
很大一部分原因在于大尺寸内屏的屏幕比例。虽然很多游戏会适配 4:3 的比例，但仍有很多游戏并不支持，导致画面要么被丑陋地拉伸，要么出现巨大的黑边。以 炉石传说 为例，我只能在“屏幕三分之一被遮挡”或“强行拉伸填满屏幕但导致画面显示不全”之间二选一。

魔幻, 卡牌, 半Q版, 2D, 回合, unity3D, 益智, 休闲, 道具收费

我曾多次尝试全屏运行这款游戏，结果却因为画面被裁剪而看不清战场边缘的卡牌。当然，这很大程度上取决于开发者。显然，暴雪有资源去更新 炉石传说 以适配 Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra 的方屏。但是，我已经测试折叠屏手机七年了，情况并没有好转。如果暴雪到现在还没动作，我怀疑短期内也不会有改观。我实在不想把希望寄托在个别开发者身上。
结果就是，我大部分时间都在折叠状态下玩手游，这在某种程度上违背了拥有大屏折叠设备的初衷，不是吗？即便三星在 Fold 7 和 Fold 8 Ultra 上大幅改进了屏幕比例，其外屏依然比普通的直板手机更窄，这本身也会带来其他问题。
表面上看，iPhone Duo 似乎也会面临类似的问题。它的内屏和外屏都采用了奇特的 1.4:1 比例，正好介于 16:9 和 4:3 之间。但区别在于，苹果对开发者一向以严格著称。该公司已经发布了针对 iPhone Duo 的开发指南，其中第一条就是要求开发者构建支持动态调整大小的应用。
当然，阵痛期肯定会有的。可能需要几个月的时间，主流游戏才能适配这种新形态。但别忘了，苹果在发布会上提到了 iPad。大多数手游——包括 炉石传说 ——都原生支持苹果平板电脑的各种屏幕比例。苹果多年来一直将这些准则列入其设计文档中，这也是为什么应用在不同苹果设备之间通常能无缝运行的原因。
公平地说，谷歌的开发者文档中也有类似的准则，但区别在于安卓平台将游戏视为这一规则的例外。这就是为什么你想玩的游戏是否真正支持折叠屏就像是在赌博。对于 iPhone Duo，内外屏比例一致确实有所帮助，这降低了调整分辨率的技术门槛。无论如何，我至少有信心苹果的折叠屏会有更多能在内屏上“完美运行”的游戏。现在，也许我终于可以在折叠屏上玩我那幼稚的小卡牌游戏，而不用忍受巨大的黑边了。

items.title: 《死或生：维纳斯璀璨假期 6 Last Round》项目经理爆料光荣特库摩将减少游戏的“性感服装”，引发玩家热议

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260911/PgouPTbucgllhcx.jpg
《死或生：维纳斯璀璨假期 6 Last Round》项目经理井内强（Tsuyoshi Iuchi）在解释为何光荣特库摩（Koei Tecmo）团队正在减少制作性感服装后，引发了格斗游戏社区的争论。
死或生：维纳斯璀璨假期
冒险, 恋爱模拟, 动作冒险
查看更多 立即下载
《死或生：维纳斯璀璨假期》是一个拥有忠实粉丝群和专门竞技圈的格斗游戏系列。尽管如此，它也以福利最多的格斗游戏系列而闻名——考虑到摇晃物理效果、恋爱模拟要素浓厚的衍生游戏以及在几乎每一部《DoA》作品中都大量存在的性感服饰，这个标签很难撕掉。
虽然《死或生：维纳斯璀璨假期 7》正在开发中，但《DoA 6 Last Round》仍在更新内容，包括昨天刚刚公布的新角色。湊（Minato）的加入并非没有争议；一些粉丝指责这位女学生是穗香（Honoka）的“复制粘贴”版，而其他人则指向了9月9日《法米通》（Famitsu）的一篇采访，其中包含了该游戏开发团队的一些引发分歧的言论。
在这些言论中，有一条尤为突出：项目经理井内强确认，光荣特库摩决定减少为《死或生：维纳斯璀璨假期》角色制作性感服装。这对该系列来说是一个巨大的变化，也遭到了粉丝群的抵制和困惑。
井内表示，原因在于玩家在进行竞技比赛时使用此类服装会感到“尴尬”。（这并不奇怪；多年来，在多款不同的格斗游戏中，女性角色的泳装类服装在众多电竞比赛中都被禁止或限制使用。）
他表示：“我理解有些人期待性感服装，但实际上，由于尴尬和其他因素，性感服装在竞技比赛中的使用频率往往较低。例如，即使在排位赛中，你也不经常看到对手穿着泳装，对吧？这一次，我们的目标是制作‘喜欢该角色的玩家会持续使用’的服装，因此性感元素自然会被降至最低。”
这并不是唯一引起玩家注意的评论；导演中村明宏（Akihiro Nakamura）也回应了《法米通》关于湊的招式表的问题，该媒体指出其招式与穗香惊人地相似。
他解释说：“虽然她们都使用相同的技术，但关键区别在于背景故事：穗香拥有能瞬间模仿任何所见技术的先天能力，而湊则是通过设备学习和刻苦钻研来掌握的。此外，穗香喜欢观看武术和职业摔角，所以她会根据个人爱好选择喜欢的技术，而湊在学习技术时则考虑到了视觉吸引力和舞蹈的乐趣。”
这一回答，结合团队减少性感服装的决定，让《DoA》社区感到既沮丧又失望，引发了玩家在线上的抵制浪潮。
“我们还能指望什么？”一位粉丝在社交平台上写道。“他们根本不在乎粉丝或游戏。他们只想用最少的努力从社区里再榨取几美元。我已经能预见到《DOA7》没有跨平台对战或回滚代码（rollback netcode），而光荣会说：‘请付80美元。’”
“当湊对阵穗香时会发生什么？她也要偷走她偷来的招式吗？”知名社区成员 Emery Reigns 说道。
甚至日本玩家也对湊的招式表感到不满，有人写道：“又一次圈钱？我为6代掏了钱，但我几乎继承不了任何东西，甚至不能改发色更别提强化了——实际上反而更糟了，不是吗？太让人失望了。”
“看来是 Dead 多过 Alive 了。” —— Hikariko Nikushimi，2026年9月10日
“当湊对阵穗香时会发生什么？她也要偷走她偷来的招式吗？😂😂😂😂” —— EmeryReigns，2026年9月9日
“Team Ninja 和光荣特库摩对《死或生：维纳斯璀璨假期》玩家群的愚弄简直令人难以置信。请看看这些废话。” —— Mike Hollow，2026年9月9日
《死或生：维纳斯璀璨假期 7》仍在开发中，截至发稿时还没有发布日期。《死或生：维纳斯璀璨假期 6 Last Round》在6月发布时反响平平，许多玩家抱怨缺乏回滚代码和跨平台对战功能，玩家们希望光荣特库摩团队在下一部《DoA》作品中能考虑他们的反馈。

others.title: 《Wardogs》首日销量突破 100 万份，Steam 并发玩家峰值突破 30 万

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260911/Vjloicbucgllfpl.jpg
Wardogs 销量已突破百万大关，并席卷了 Steam 同时在线人数榜单。
今天早些时候，开发商 Bulkhead 推出了全新的全规模战争 FPS 游戏 Wardogs。这款游戏是今年最受期待的射击游戏之一，玩家们正大批涌入。据开发商称，该游戏的销量已突破百万份，SteamDB 显示该游戏的最高同时在线人数已超过 30 万。

“在进入抢先体验阶段之初就突破百万销量，这简直太疯狂了，”Bulkhead 首席执行官 Joe Brammer 表示，“在过去的几个月里，我们一直在向大家展示 Wardogs 究竟是什么，不是什么，甚至一度列出了十个不买它的理由。我们不希望玩家因为盲目跟风而购买。因此，看到超过一百万玩家选择在抢先体验发布时加入并体验游戏，对我们所有人来说都意义重大。但这仍处于抢先体验阶段。我们还有很多东西需要修复、改进，还有更多内容需要构建。玩家现在能做的最好的事情就是继续玩下去，告诉我们你们的想法，并继续为我们创造那些精彩的 Wardogs 瞬间。”
Wardogs 目前仅在 PC 平台上推出，这使得它的首发销售数字更加令人印象深刻，但它 确实 会登陆主机平台。Bulkhead 证实 Wardogs 的目标是在 2028 年登陆 PS5 和 Xbox，但尚未提供具体的发布日期。开发商还指出，他们预计热度最终会降温，因为他们计划在发布新内容时采取稳扎稳打的策略，因此玩家人数可能会出现下降。

无论如何，对于一款全新的多人射击游戏来说，这是一个强劲的开端。随着新内容的加入，这款游戏能否持续吸引玩家回归还有待观察，但看到除了 使命召唤21：黑色行动6 和 《Battlefield 3™》 之外还有其他游戏能产生如此大的影响力，这感觉很棒。Wardogs 试图在像 Armageddon War:Old Era Wreckers / 大鏖战:旧时代的残党 这样的军事模拟游戏和像 《Battlefield 3™》 这样稍微休闲一点的游戏之间寻找独特的平衡，从而产生一种紧张、写实但规模宏大的体验，并充满了突发状况。到目前为止，玩家们似乎非常买账，随着口碑的传播，其受众群体可能会继续增长。

items.title: iPhone Duo 丝滑的启闭动画已在 Galaxy Fold 8 上成功复刻

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260911/ksRJvnbucgieqDj.png
Apple 昨天在“Suprise and Shine”发布会上公布了其首款折叠屏手机 iPhone Duo。虽然折叠屏的概念对 Apple 来说是新鲜的，但它正进入一个庞大的现有折叠屏手机市场。因此，自然有人已经在 Android 手机上重现了 Duo 那整洁的开屏动画。
虽然 iPhone Duo 要到 10 月 23 日才上市，但早期展示的更有趣的功能之一是 Apple A20 Pro 芯片同时驱动两个显示屏的能力。这使得 Duo 拥有一个开启和关闭的动画，从某个角度看，就像手机的显示屏在扩张一样。这种效果是 Apple 新手机独有的，但 Reddit 上的一位软件开发者能够在 Galaxy Z Fold 上重现它，尽管这并不是完全系统级的。
在用户 moomanjohnny 分享到 GalaxyFold 子版块的视频中，你可以看到 Galaxy Z Fold 8 的外屏在手机打开时淡出，而内屏则获取主屏幕的图像并在手机完全打开后将其展开。这是通过获取铰链传感器的数据，然后使用主屏幕截图创建过渡动画来完成的——这还没完全准备好进行系统级应用。

阻碍这一功能在三星启动器中全面实现的原因是，所需的权限仅存在于 Android 的后台进程中。在随后的讨论中，moomanjohnny 解释说：“SystemUI 在系统中拥有特权，它可以将自己置于应用程序之上，并告诉其他应用程序如何渲染。SystemUI 接收表面列表，并可以使用 SurfaceFlinger 在屏幕上将其合成到想要的位置。”这是因为安全风险。“不幸的是，就我所知，没有供应商将这些 API 开放给 SystemUI 以外的任何东西。”
这种开屏动画是否会在 Galaxy Z Fold 8 上得到支持尚无定论，但显而易见的是硬件能力是具备的。考虑到三星移动的 Twitter 页面在 Apple 发布会期间对 iPhone Duo 的反应，这种功能有可能在未来的某个时间点出现在三星的 Fold 系列中。

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260911/ymTXusbucgiefmC.jpg
一位风险投资家建议，在全球末日之后，宝可梦传说：阿尔宙斯 卡牌可能会被用作货币。
宝可梦传说：阿尔宙斯
冒险, Q萌, 卡通
我们爆肝了28小时，认为《宝可梦传说：阿尔宙斯》部分实现，甚至超出了玩家对于《精灵宝可梦》次世代进化的想象。
查看更多 立即下载
风险投资公司 Griffin Gaming Partners 的创始人 Pete Levin 表示，如果世界当前的经济因某种可怕的灾难而崩溃，宝可梦传说：阿尔宙斯 集换式卡牌这一“全球现象”将非常适合作为一种新型货币。
Levin 声称管理着超过 16 亿美元的游戏资产，并且凑巧的是，他本人也拥有约 50 万张集换式卡牌。他在接受采访时解释说，对于收藏家来说，宝可梦传说：阿尔宙斯 卡牌仍然是利润丰厚的资产——并暗示即使在灾难降临后，它们的价值至少在一定程度上仍会保留。
“宝可梦传说：阿尔宙斯 是一种全球现象，”Levin 说道。“我完全相信，如果世界明天遭遇末日，第二天全球货币就会变成 宝可梦传说：阿尔宙斯 卡牌。”
“宝可梦传说：阿尔宙斯 卡牌的表现比标普 500 指数高出 3000%，”他继续说道。“它起源于日本，在 90 年代末和 2000 年代初风靡全球。随后它经历了一个巅峰时期和一个低谷时期，从那以后，它一直处于抛物线式的增长曲线上。这确实推动了集换式卡牌国际市场的扩张。”
尽管如果大家都开始使用“喷火龙”而不是零钱，Levin 个人将从中获利，但他还指出了他对这一预言充满信心的其他几个原因。
首先，像 PSA 这样的卡牌评级公司现在已经将卡牌质量等级标准化，并提供真实性证明。有了这些，卡牌就有了明确的可量化价值——即使其价格仍由市场决定。此外还有所谓的“大童（kidult）”现象，即成年人现在约占全球玩具销售额的 30%——而且这一数字还在上升。
“已经成长起来的一代人对这些玩具、复古视频游戏、集换式卡牌和漫画书怀有怀旧情结，而且他们现在拥有可支配收入，”Levin 总结道。“因此，这也是市场上一个巨大的切实驱动力。”
所以，别管那个关于未来 10 年 AI 有超过 10% 的概率终结文明的说法了。如果你口袋里有几张“皮卡丘插画师”卡牌，你可能仍然能买到几罐豆子。
关于我们都应该开始囤积 宝可梦传说：阿尔宙斯 卡牌以备末日之需的消息，可能对缓解目前 宝可梦传说：阿尔宙斯 卡牌短缺的问题毫无帮助。卡牌稀缺已导致美国零售商 Target 开始切开包装盒以威慑黄牛。在日本，一些新产品的发售仅限日本居民购买，而某些地点甚至推出了针对成人和儿童的人脸识别系统，以限制每日的卡牌购买量。
由于 宝可梦传说：阿尔宙斯 卡牌的普及程度飙升以及稀有卡牌的公认价值，在过去几年里，它们已成为黄牛和窃贼的首要目标。新卡牌的发布经常被抢购一空，而 The 宝可梦传说：阿尔宙斯 Company 似乎无法或不愿完全满足需求——尽管仅去年一年就印制了惊人的 100 亿张卡牌。

items.title: GTA6 限定版 PS5 手柄预售挤爆 PlayStation 商店，黄牛已开始在 eBay 加价转卖

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260911/stWhVrbucghEBlF.png
今天早上，GTA6 的新款 PS5 手柄正式开启预售，而整个预购体验极其混乱。
GTA6
动作冒险, 角色扮演
PC 玩家们，我知道你们很急，但你们先 别 急。
查看更多 立即下载
正如你所料，玩家对任何与 GTA6 相关的事物都有着极高的热情。当索尼上周宣布将为两款限量版 GTA6 主题 PS5 手柄开启预售时，几乎可以预见会出现大量的黄牛抢购、商店错误以及各种混乱——而这正是今天早上预售开启时的真实写照。

在预售开始前半小时，我就进入了 PlayStation 官方商店的排队序列。然而当预售正式开启后，我却被踢回了队尾，显示等待时间超过一小时。幸运的是，这个时间很快就减半了，可能是因为部分玩家不愿等待而离开了队列。但即便如此，我还是遇到了问题：PlayStation 网站在我尝试登录账户时不断报错，迫使我不得不在另一台设备的浏览器中重新打开商店。虽然最终我成功下单，但这种本可以避免的摩擦确实让人心累。
到目前为止，这些手柄在各大零售商处似乎已接近售罄，不过在撰写本文时仍有少量库存。GameStop 和 Best Buy 的白色款已经卖光，而 Target 和亚马逊似乎还有现货。与此同时，黑色款手柄为 PlayStation Direct 独占，目前看起来仍可购买。
PlayStation 实施了每个账户限购一个手柄的制度，这虽然能在一定程度上限制黄牛，但无法完全根除问题。目前这些手柄在 eBay 上的转售价几乎翻了一番，但尚不清楚是否真的有人会去买单。目前还不确定这些手柄的库存能支撑多久，以及售罄后是否还会补货。
随着手柄预售的开启，距离 GTA6 正式发售已不足两个月。营销活动正处于白热化阶段，但接下来的动向尚不明确。在发布了详尽的深度实机演示之后，还会不会有新的预告片？Rockstar 会在发售前谈论 GTA Online 吗？虽然仍有很多疑问，但至少我们已经进入了最后的倒计时。
GTA6 将于 11 月 19 日在 PS5 和 Xbox Series X|S 平台上发售。

items.title: 在《破碎怪谈：恶意取关: Don’t Lie》中通过恐怖元素探讨的主题

content.v: 摘要
各位 XBOX 的玩家大家好！
我是 Sebastiano Serafini，Serafini Productions 的首席执行官兼创始人，该团队致力于打造 破碎怪谈：恶意取关 宇宙。今天，我们非常激动地宣布 破碎怪谈：恶意取关 系列的最新作品 破碎怪谈：恶意取关: Don’t Lie 正式发布。作为一款独立作品， 破碎怪谈：恶意取关: Don’t Lie 同时也是一个宏大叙事链条的一部分，旨在从不同视角揭示特定的社会问题。
破碎怪谈：恶意取关: Don’t Lie
破碎怪谈：恶意取关: Don’t Lie 讲述了一位名叫 Junko 的年轻“蛰居族”（hikikomori）的故事，她必须在现实彻底崩塌前直面自己创伤性的过去。对于不了解这一概念的玩家，蛰居族是指因各种社会或心理原因，选择与社会隔绝、寻求孤立的个人。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260911/JfnzPvbucggpqcb.jpg
随着 Junko 与外部世界的隔绝，记忆与现实的界限开始破碎，熟悉的地方变成了她过去经历的投影。她必须逐渐面对那些自己多年来一直在压抑的人、事和情感，否则就会迷失自我。
它与 破碎怪谈：恶意取关: Don’t Watch 有什么联系？
Junko 和 Shinji（ 破碎怪谈：恶意取关: Don’t Watch 的主角）于 2020 年在一家康复中心相识。他们当时都在接受针对各自心理障碍的治疗，这些障碍最终导致他们成为了蛰居族。 破碎怪谈：恶意取关: Don’t Watch 讲述了 Shinji 的故事及其陷入孤立的起源，而 破碎怪谈：恶意取关: Don’t Lie 则是 Junko 的故事。
https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260911/PDTvkhbucggpsgF.jpg
破碎怪谈：恶意取关 系列的灵感来源
破碎怪谈：恶意取关 的灵感源于我们想要创造一个相互关联的叙事宇宙，用以探索那些与我们息息相关的社会议题。
我喜欢这种碎片化叙事的构思：每一款游戏都可以独立存在，探讨各自的角色和主题，但好奇心强的玩家可以通过深入挖掘，逐渐将这些碎片连接起来。
从一开始，我们就希望 破碎怪谈：恶意取关 不仅仅是一系列恐怖游戏。恐怖是我们讲述故事的媒介，但每款游戏的核心都是非常真实的人性体验。
“蛰居族”这个话题对我来说尤其有趣，因为我在日本生活多年，目睹了人们对社会退缩现象的讨论和看法。当然，孤立和社会退缩绝非日本独有的问题，但日本是我最初对该议题产生浓厚兴趣的视角。
破碎怪谈：恶意取关 宇宙的下一篇章
随着这一新篇章的发布，我们还在探索另一个在身边日益普遍的现象：人与 AI 伴侣的关系。越来越多的人开始求助于 AI 工具，不仅是为了获取信息，还为了讨论个人问题或寻求建议。这种观察成为了我们游戏中角色 Miki-chan 的灵感来源之一。

你们目前所看到的仅仅是个开始。在这个宇宙中，我们还有许多故事想要讲述，这就是为什么我们非常高兴能有 Wired Productions 和 Shochiku 这样的合作伙伴支持我们的旅程。希望随着 破碎怪谈：恶意取关 的成长，这些合作能够持续下去，因为还有许多主题、角色和故事值得我们去探索。能够通过电子游戏来讲述这些故事，并让这些故事对玩家产生意义，这是我创作 破碎怪谈：恶意取关 最有成就感的部分。
感谢所有玩过 破碎怪谈：恶意取关: Don’t Watch 的玩家，希望你们喜欢 破碎怪谈：恶意取关: Don’t Lie 。你今天就可以在 XBOX SERIES X|S 和 PC 上体验它。

items.title: 《使命召唤21：黑色行动6》反作弊负责人揭秘：为何动视对疑似作弊玩家采取“影子封禁”而非立即永封？

others.title: 《使命召唤》反作弊负责人透露为何动视影子禁止涉嫌作弊的玩家而不是立即永久禁止他们

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260911/rhELrxbucgeqEBl.png
使命召唤21：黑色行动6 反作弊系统高级总监解释了为什么 Activision 会对玩家实施影子禁令，而不是直接将他们从游戏中永久封禁。
多年来，关于作弊以及在像 使命召唤21：黑色行动6 这样的大作中实施反作弊一直存在很多摩擦。游戏中的反作弊并不完美；它会犯错并误封不该被封禁的人，在启动游戏时（如安全启动等）可能会引发麻烦，而且一些玩家会被放入模糊的“受限匹配”池中，即所谓的影子禁令。
反作弊的运作方式一直充满神秘感。使命召唤21：黑色行动6 游戏安全高级总监 David Andrews 介绍了 Ricochet 反作弊系统的更多细节。在采访中，他被问及为什么 Activision 选择对涉嫌作弊的玩家进行影子禁令，而不是简单地当场封禁他们。
Andrews 表示：“我们会将可疑账号放入受限匹配中，以便在进行其他检查或等待其他数据时将他们隔离。我们正在对该账号进行更全面的审查过程，看看究竟发生了什么。这是一种权宜之计，可以在不造成永久性影响或对该账号及玩家产生不可撤销影响的情况下立即移除他们，这为我们提供了喘息的空间来查明账号的情况，如果只是虚惊一场，则可以将他们恢复到正常玩家群体中。”
Andrews 接着指出，Activision 有多种处理涉嫌作弊者的方法，但使用影子禁令等技术可以潜在地引导玩家行为修正，并让他们有机会在没有问题的情况下继续游戏。

“我们还通过受限匹配进行了一些行为修正，告诉玩家：‘嘿，你不能再进行刚才的那种行为，如果你停止，你就可以回来。’ 我们有很多执法手段。我们有受限匹配、排位赛封禁、远程游玩封禁、临时和永久账号停封，还有硬件封禁。我们可以做各种各样的事情，每当处理特定风格或类型的作弊时，我们都会评估哪种方式对这群作弊者更有意义。他们能被引导回归吗？我们最终对此有 100% 的信心吗？是否需要更多研究？无论情况如何，我们都会找出合适的处理方法。”
使命召唤21：黑色行动6: Modern Warfare 4 将于下个月发布，Infinity Ward 旨在积极听取玩家反馈。反作弊是 使命召唤21：黑色行动6 游戏形象的重要组成部分，团队在最近的测试中测试了 Ricochet 在 MW4 中的实施情况。虽然这确实导致了一名职业选手被误封，但 使命召唤21：黑色行动6 通讯团队纠正了这一问题并确认这是一个错误。
使命召唤21：黑色行动6 一直饱受作弊困扰，尤其是在免费下载的大逃杀游戏 使命召唤：战区2 中。Activision 为此投入了大量的时间、金钱和精力，甚至在法庭上起诉作弊软件制作者，尽管与所有游戏开发商一样，它在反作弊战争中仍面临着艰巨的挑战。

items.title: Wardogs 将登陆 Xbox 和 PS5 平台，但仍需等待一段时间

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260911/JDUwWYbucgeqgas.png
Wardogs，这款在 Steam 上爆红的全新全面战争 FPS 游戏，已正式宣布将登陆主机平台……但还需要一段时间。
作为发布计划的一部分，Wardogs 背后的开发团队 Bulkhead 确认将把这款大规模射击游戏带到主机平台。该游戏预计于 2028 年登陆 Xbox 和 PS5，但从今天起已在 Steam 上开启抢先体验。游戏首发售价为 39.99 美元，并计划随着游戏内容的扩充而涨价。此举旨在回馈在早期阶段支持游戏的粉丝，而不是对一款未完成的产品收取 60 至 70 美元的全价。
“Wardogs 雄心勃勃，虽然目前还不够完善，仍有很长的路要走，但这 balanced 才是抢先体验应有的样子，”Bulkhead 首席执行官 Joe Brammer 表示。“我们将游戏交到玩家手中，倾听他们的反馈，并承担必要的风险将其打造成能够长久发展的作品。最重要的是，我们希望玩家能联机互动、彼此交流，找回我们成长过程中玩 FPS 游戏的那种乐趣。”
这一切都表明 Wardogs 可能将 1.0 正式版的发布目标定在 2028 年，因为与 Xbox 不同，PlayStation 对其平台上的抢先体验游戏筛选极其严格。像 深海迷航2 这样的大作在抢先体验阶段也不得不跳过 PS5，虽然也有例外，但我目前对 Wardogs 成为这些例外之一并不抱太大希望。

items.title: GTA 4 曾是 Xbox 360 对抗 PS3 的“动真格”时刻

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260911/lmLlBPbucgbBDte.png
这是 Ryan McCaffrey 的观点文章，他在 2002 年至 2012 年初代 Xbox 和 Xbox 360 时代曾在《官方 Xbox 杂志》工作，之后加入媒体并一直担任“Xbox 专家”。在 Xbox 25 周年到来之际，他将分享他在该平台第一个四分之一世纪里的回忆。

随着备受期待的 GTA6 距离发售仅剩两个多月时间，回想不久前 Grand Theft Auto V 传承版 系列还是 PlayStation 独占游戏是很值得的。GTA 3 和 侠盗猎车手：罪恶都市 直到 2003 年 11 月才以 GTA Double Pack 的形式登陆初代 Xbox，这意味着 GTA 3 在 PS2 上独占了两年，侠盗猎车手：罪恶都市 独占了一年。与此同时，Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas – The Definitive Edition 于 2005 年 6 月登陆 Xbox，比最初的 PS2 版本晚了相对较短的八个月。

关键在于，当当时的 Xbox 负责人 Peter Moore——可以说是经营 Xbox 业务以来最出色的表演者——在 2006 年 E3 展上卷起袖子，露出二头肌上的 Grand Theft Auto V 传承版 IV 标志“纹身”，并宣布 Rockstar 的次世代 GTA 不仅会在 Xbox 360 上同步发售，而且 Xbox 还将获得两个限时独占的扩展包（后来证明是优秀的 The Lost and Damned 和绝对顶级的 The Ballad of Gay Tony）时，这在当时是一件天大的事。Microsoft 为此特权向 Rockstar 支付了 5000 万美元的支票，但这钱花得值。至少对 Xbox 360 玩家来说是这样，在 2006 年 E3 展 Xbox 新闻发布会之前，以及 PS3 发售之前，许多玩家就已经投资了这款率先上市的高清时代次世代主机，因为 使命召唤：战区2、上古卷轴IV：湮灭重制版、幽灵行动：尖峰战士2 和 Fight Night Round 3 等游戏都已经证明了其强大的次世代实力。

查看更多 立即下载
Microsoft 取得了巨大的开局（正如 Moore 常说的，“第一个达到 1000 万的就赢了”），通过这次 GTA 4 交易，公司表明它站在了早期“加入”Xbox 360 的数百万玩家一边。在面对行业最大的特许经营权时，Xbox 360 玩家不会成为二等公民。
在我看来，GTA 4 是所有极具讽刺意味的 GTA 游戏中最好笑的一部。

当 GTA 4 最终在 2008 年 4 月发布时（在 2007 年秋季跳票后），它当然是一部从头开始打造的杰作，从技术上讲，它与 GTA 3 三部曲没有任何共同点。它带我们回到了 Liberty City，尽管这是一个完全重塑的城市，看起来令人难以置信，而且充满了小细节和可做的事情。在我看来，它是所有讽刺天才的 GTA 游戏中最好笑的一部，因为它拥有搞笑的游戏内互联网（可以在网吧访问……还记得那些吗？）、令人难忘的角色如 Brucie，以及让人捧腹大笑的游戏内电视节目如“The Men’s Room”。

就个人而言，它发售时正值我离婚后不久，我有着非常有意义的回忆：我最好的朋友 Robert 在游戏发售后立即从亚利桑那州飞过来陪我，和我一起享受游戏。当然，那时还没有 GTA Online，所以我们就轮流交换手柄，每个人都为拿着手柄的人所做的疯狂举动而狂欢（并大笑）。在他陪我的那几天里，我们一定在 GTA 4 中投入了几十个小时，我永远会将 GTA 4 与我在最需要的时候所获得的一点点乐趣、轻松和友谊联系在一起。

后来，正如我提到的，The Lost and Damned 发布了（并在 Xbox 上独占了一年多），它对同名机车帮的关注是典型 GTA 配方的超级酷的转型。再后来，The Ballad of Gay Tony（六个月的 Xbox 360 独占）展示了 Rockstar 无可挑剔的叙事和角色塑造；嘿，我个人会将其列为有史以来任何游戏最好的 DLC 或扩展包之一。然后在 Xbox 360 世代的末尾，我们迎来了 GTA 5……但遗憾的是，完全没有最初承诺的单人 DLC，更不用说独占 DLC 了。

无论如何，我认为 GTA 4 在 Xbox 360 上的同步发售以及随后的独占 DLC 可能是 Xbox 品牌从文化角度来看的巅峰时期。你必须拥有一台 Xbox 360——如果不是为了它已经拥有的强大游戏阵容，那就是为了独占的 GTA 4 扩展包。它与 2007 年 光环3 的发售旗鼓相当。事实上，从 2007 年秋季（见证了 光环3、Mass Effect、生化奇兵 2、Call of Duty 4: Modern Warfare、摇滚乐队3 和 刺客信条4：黑旗 记忆重置 的发售）到 2008 年 4 月 GTA 4 的发售，可能是任何主机历史上最辉煌的六个月左右。

items.title: PlayStation's Fairgames Seemingly Remerges With First Gameplay, New Codename, and Private Playtest
items.summary: PlayStation's online heist game, Fairgames, has seemingly re-appeared under a codename with first gameplay and

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/10/fairgames-1789067945402.jpg
PlayStation's online heist game, Fairgames, has seemingly re-appeared under a codename with first gameplay and invites to a playtest.

Three years ago, PlayStation announced a new online shooter known as Fairgames. It's a competitive heist game, which is a fairly unique concept on paper, but it has reportedly had all kinds of development troubles, including the departure of studio founder Jade Raymond and the game's creative director Daniel Drapeau . Their departures came after staff inside the studio began to express concerns for the game following negative internal playtests. The game has largely gone unacknowledged by PlayStation since its announcement, but development has marched on.

Now, the game has seemingly quitely reemerged under the codename Project Espresso. The game was added to Player.gg , a website that allows developers to connect with players for playtesting. Although the game is under a codename and the developer is being kept under wraps, the listing includes a pretty sizable gameplay trailer which looks strikingly similar to Fairgames. It has a similar art-style, similar concept, and there's a disclaimer that the game is in development for PS5 and PC.
Looks like this is the first official look at gameplay for FAIRGAME$ aka Break In https://t.co/kuphMNor1Y pic.twitter.com/W5KE8nEO9b

Earlier this year, PlayStation also filed a trademark for a new game known as Break In , which some suspected may be the new title for Fairgames. IGN has reached out to PlayStation for comment regarding the situation and will update the story if we hear anything.

Although Fairgames has been largely shrouded in secrecy, it hasn't stopped gamers from casting doubt on it. PlayStation's other big live service offering, Concord, was a catastrophic bomb. Additionally, Marathon has failed to impress, The Last of Us Online was canceled, Destiny 2 is no longer being supported, and there's a general disdain for live-service games lately. Outside of PlayStation's first-party offerings, Highguard was meant to be another big live-service title, but was dead within two months.

Whether Fairgames (or whatever its final name ends up being) can buck trends and get people interested remains to be seen. It's an interesting time for Sony, as it's navigating nonstop chaos; last night, it was confirmed Hideo Kojima was parting ways with PlayStation after the platform planned to cancel Kojima's ambitious next-gen game, Physint. Xbox stepped in and offered to save it, strengthening the company's relationship with the auteur. Kojima is also developing a new horror game with Xbox known as OD.

PlayStation has also been in hot water with players after its decisions to kill support for physical media in 2028 , shut down Bluepoint a few years after acquiring it, and end support for single-player games on PC . Another live service bomb would be a big hit to PlayStation's PR right now, so hopefully these playtests can shape it into something appealing to a broad audience.

items.title: 据报道，沙特阿拉伯正在考虑将 Electronic Arts 与 Savvy Games Group 合并
items.summary: The country finalized its majority acquisition of Electronic Arts in August.

content.v: With Electronic Arts now almost fully owned by Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund , a Bloomberg report says the wealth fund is now giving thought to merging it with the PIF's other gaming crown jewel, Savvy Games Group.

No decisions have been made at this point, according to the report, which also says that any potential merger would likely wait until the completion of the PIF's acquisition of Chinese mobile gaming company Moonton for $6 billion, a deal that was announced in March . The proposed merger would also have to overcome various regulatory hurdles.

From the perspective of the PIF, and by extension Saudi Arabia—the fund's chairman is Mohammed bin Salman, the de facto ruler of the nation—a merger would seem to make sense. Savvy Games Group is a behemoth in its own right, with subsidiaries including esports org ESL Faceit Group , Pokémon Go creator Scopely , and—soon—Moonton. Bringing that and EA's own significant operations under one umbrella would presumably simplify the PIF's gaming strategy going forward.

The PIF may also be motivated to make a merger by the fact that money, even for the ever-flush Saudi kingdom, is getting a bit tight . Mergers typically result in the elimination of duplicated operations and services, and their related expenses. As we've seen many times in the past, that means layoffs: EA employees are already bracing for deep cuts as the company moves to take on the $18 billion debt load incurred as a result of the PIF's acquisition of the company earlier this year, and it's not unreasonable to think that the new Saudi owners would be looking for other ways to pare back costs.

How a proposed merger would fare under regulatory scrutiny is less clear. The resulting company would be a global powerhouse, effectively under the control of a single person—a person who's been credibly accused of ordering the murder and dismemberment of journalist Jamal Khashoggi in 2018, don't forget.

That might seem like the sort of thing that's destined to run into roadblocks, but bin Salman is also close with current US president Donald Trump, while the PIF's acquisition of EA in the first place was facilitated in part by Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner. Those connections may have helped the PIF avoid the aggressive (and ultimately futile ) actions faced by Microsoft when it acquired Activision Blizzard, and they may prove useful again in the future too.
Electronic Arts declined to comment on the report. I've also reached out to the Public Investment Fund and Savvy Games Group for comment, and will update if I receive a reply.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/06/23/deadoralive6-lastround-review-blogroll-1782252930652.jpg
Dead or Alive 6 Last Round Project Manager Tsuyoshi Iuchi has sparked a debate within the fighting game community after explaining why the team at Koei Tecmo is dialing back on making sexy costumes.

Dead or Alive is a fighting game franchise with a fiercely loyal fanbase and a dedicated competitive scene. Despite these factors, it’s also known as the fighting game series with the most fanservice — a label that’s hard to get away from, given the jiggle physics, dating-sim-heavy spinoff games, and sexy outfits that exist in abundance in almost every DoA title.

While Dead or Alive 7 is in active development, DoA 6 Last Round is still getting content, including a new character that was just announced yesterday. Minato’s addition to the roster hasn’t come without controversy; some fans are accusing the schoolgirl of being a copy/paste of Honoka, while others are pointing toward a September 9 Famitsu interview that included some divisive remarks from the game’s development team.

Of these remarks, one is standing out from the rest: Project Manager Tsuyoshi Iuchi confirmed that Koei Tecmo is making the decision to step back from making more sexy outfits for Dead or Alive’s characters. This is a big change for the franchise, and one that’s been met with backlash and confusion from its fanbase.

The reason for this, Iuchi says, is because players are "embarrassed" to use such costumes when playing competitively. (This isn’t a huge surprise; swimsuit-style costumes for female characters have been banned or restricted at numerous esports tournaments across several different fighting games over the years.)

“I understand that some people are hoping for sexy costumes, but actually, sexy costumes tend to be used less frequently in competitive games due to embarrassment and other factors. For example, even in ranked matches, you don't often see your opponents wearing swimsuit costumes, right? This time, we're aiming for costumes that ‘people who like that character will continue to use,’ so the sexy elements are naturally kept to a minimum,” he said.

That’s not the only comment that’s catching players’ eyes; Director Akihiro Nakamura also responded to Famitsu’s question regarding Minato’s moveset, which the outlet noted was strikingly similar to Honoka’s.

“While they both use the same techniques, the key difference lies in their backstory: Honoka has an innate ability to instantly imitate any technique she sees, while Minato learns by studying through a device and through hard work,” he explained. “Additionally, Honoka enjoys watching martial arts and professional wrestling, so she chooses techniques she likes as a hobby, whereas Minato learns techniques with the visual appeal and enjoyment of dance in mind.”
This answer, combined with team's decision to slow down on sexy costumes, has left the DoA community equal parts frustrated and disappointed, leading to a wave of backlash from players online.

“What did we expect?” one fan wrote on X. “They don't care about the fans or the game. They want to shake a couple of more dollars out of the community with bare-minimum effort. I can already see DOA7 not having crossplay or rollback [netcode] and Koei saying, ‘$80 bucks, please.’”
“What happens when Minato fights Honoka? Is she going to steal her stolen moves, too?” prominent community member Emery Reigns said .

Even Japanese players aren’t happy with Minato’s moveset, with one writing , "Another cash grab? I shelled out for 6, but I can barely carry anything over, can't even change my hair color let alone power up — it's actually worse off, isn't it? Way too disappointing.”

Team Ninja and Koei Tecmo have mugged off the Dead or Alive player base beyond belief. Please read this shit. pic.twitter.com/bFiivxq1v9

Dead or Alive 7 is still being developed, and it doesn’t have a release date at the time of writing. Dead or Alive 6 Last Round received middling reviews on its release in June, with many players — and even our own reviewers at IGN — bemoaning the lack of rollback netcode and lack of cross-platform play on launch, leaving players hopeful that the team at Koei Tecmo will take their feedback into consideration for its next DoA title.

items.title: Wardogs Has A Massive Start On Steam, But Players Face Brutal Server Queues
items.summary: A big new military FPS, Wardogs (not to be confused with the 2016 Jonah Hill/Miles Teller crime-comedy War Dog

content.v: A big new military FPS, Wardogs (not to be confused with the 2016 Jonah Hill/Miles Teller crime-comedy War Dogs) launched today in early access on Steam, and it's off to a hot start. The shooter reached 300,000 peak concurrent users on Steam right out of the gate and the $40 game is currently Steam's No. 1 best-seller. Pretty impressive for a game that the developer told you not to buy .

Given the flood of players, developer Bulkhead instituted a server queue system, and this quickly became something of a meme on social media. Players shared screenshots of the queue and their place in it--some people reported having more than 300,000 people in line in front of them . Yeesh.

Bulkhead responded to the brutal queueing situation, saying it was partly due to the developer being "rate limited." The company said it was working with Valve to resolve this limit and get an increase in line with "larger titles."
Things got worse, temporarily albeit, for some, as Bulkhead made the decision to kick everyone from the queue as a fix that, in theory, would help more players get into the game faster.

Bulkhead boss Joe Brammer gave an update on the queuing situation, saying the queue itself is not "specifically broken," but instead he said Wardogs didn't get the kind of treatment that AAA games receive when it comes to rate limits.
"Hang in there," Brammer said.

That wasn't the extent of the launch-day issues, as people reported getting banned for seemingly no reason. Bulkhead said it's aware of these "incorrect bans" and is working to address them immediately.
Wardogs is a large-scale military FPS featuring 100 players, divided into three teams, on a map battling it out in a fictional version of Eastern Europe.
In addition to launching Wardogs into early access, Bulkhead revealed that the game's console edition for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S will be released in 2028.

Preorders went live for Grand Theft Auto 6's new PS5 controllers this morning, and the experience was extremely chaotic.

As you might expect, there's a ravenous demand for anything related to GTA 6. When Sony announced that it'd be opening up preorders for a pair of limited edition GTA 6-themed PS5 controllers last week, it was a safe bet that there'd be scalpers, store errors, and other disruptions in abundance — and that's exactly what happened when preorders opened this morning .

I got into a queue on PlayStation's online store half an hour before preorders began, and once the flood gates were opened, I was kicked to the back the line with an hour-plus wait time. Thankfully, that time was quickly cut in half, likely from people unwilling to wait that long and leaving the queue, but even then, I still had issues. PlayStation's website kept giving me an error when I tried to sign into my account, forcing me to open the store in a new browser on another device. Eventually, I got through, but it was friction I could've done without.

So far, the controllers appear to be selling out at various retailers, though there is still some availability at the time of writing. GameStop and Best Buy are sold out of the white controller, while Target and Amazon appear to have them stock. Meanwhile, the black controller is exclusive to PlayStation Direct and appears to still be availabile.

PlayStation has implemented a system where users can only purchase one controller per account, which will likely limit some scalping, but not eradicate the issue. It's unclear how long these controllers will remain in stock and if there will be a restock if they sell out.

Marketing is in full swing now, though it's unclear what will come next. Will there be another trailer for the game following the expansive, in-depth gameplay reveal ? items.title: Palworld publishing chief worries early access has 'lost its meaning' as the rise of 'hyper-casual' gaming culture means people often don't understand what they're getting into
items.summary: "People just buy an early access game like they buy a normal game and treat it like that's the game."

content.v: Early access on Steam is a simple concept. You buy a game before it's finished, provide bug reports and feedback to developers, and help shape a project's direction and ambitions. Everybody wins: You get to play the game early, and developers earn money that helps them continue and finish their work. It's been a boon for numerous notable games over the years, including Baldur's Gate 3 and Palworld .

In an interview with GamesRadar , though, Pocketpair communications and publishing chief John Buckley said that proposition is becoming increasingly difficult for developers, because the whole idea of early access has "lost its meaning."

"Go back to the Steam Greenlight days, when Steam changed Greenlight to early access, there were a few years where it really was running and operating exactly the way I think Steam dreamed it," Buckley said.

"I think everyone knew what they were in for. The kind of people who were buying early access games knew what they were in for. They were the kind of gamers who want to be involved, they want to give feedback, they want to talk to devs. It was this really beautiful golden era."

Now, though, the rise of what Buckley called "hyper-casual mobile culture, and hyper-casual gaming culture, and live service gaming culture" has eroded that understanding, and the accord between developer and gamer that rose from it: "The culture has changed and early access, essentially, has lost its meaning. People just buy an early access game like they buy a normal game and treat it like that's the game."

There's no doubt some truth to that. Generally speaking, I subscribe to the principle that if a product is offered for sale, and people pay money for that product, they're well within their rights to expect that they're getting the product. But early access isn't quite so cut-and-dried: Steam Greenlight was a more cumbersome system, but it also clearly delineated between a work-in-progress and a final release, which early access releases often do not.

Dialed-in gamers, or those who are old enough to remember when beta testing was an actual phase of development rather than a promotional tool, may have a clearer idea of what to expect from early access games. But as gaming becomes more of a mainstream pastime it's reasonable to expect that an increasing percentage of the audience is going to neither know nor care about what early access: They just want to buy a game and play it.

Buckley doesn't believe that's necessarily a bad thing, but he did say "it's getting harder on Steam, sadly, because this culture has come through." And while he remains a believer, he also acknowledged that early access isn't ideal for every game, and that the system is "abused" by some developers.

"The biggest way it's abused now is just like, 'We'll release it now because we need money'," he said. "It's a way now to sidestep traditional funding means. It's almost become the new Kickstarter in some ways. Put out the build to get the money."

I'm not entirely sold on the idea that "put out the build to get the money" really qualifies as abuse—it is, after all, the whole basis for the early access system. But it can lead to trouble if early access sales aren't enough to support continued development, or simply through mismanaged expectations. The best thing developers who release into early access can do to avoid potential headaches, Buckley said, is to be clear about what's happening and, as much as possible, keep people fully informed.

"All we can do is try to softly educate people. I think we do an okay job. I think we try to be quite transparent. 'Hey guys, the next update's a while away. It's not going to be content-heavy, it's going to be QOL-heavy.' We try to balance it."

Pocketpair has indeed taken that approach with its fans: Buckley recently warned his followers not to expect too much from Palworld's 1.1 patch, saying it's "not planning to spend a year making a massive update."

content.v: Thief designer Randy Smith Evergreen, whose credits also include System Shock 2 and Dark Messiah: Might and Magic, thinks we need to chill out a bit when it comes to the graphics arms race. Specifically, he reckons the race should have stopped 16 years ago with Remedy's original Alan Wake, which was quite a looker back in the day.

"The fidelity curve has become outrageous," he tells us. "It's become a spectacle. I remember it was back when Alan Wake came out that I was like, 'OK, this is relatively photoreal. I know 100% that I'm on a ferry. I see that I'm going to an island in the Pacific Northwest. Why do we need more graphics? Because they just cost a ton.' Like, I 100% get it. I've got the vibe. It feels right. What else are we doing with this graphics arms race, right?"

Quite a lot, it turns out. We had high-fidelity graphics that started to look photorealistic, but then it was decided that we needed lighting and reflections that looked better than real. None of these things serve any practical purpose, but now most games that fall into the AA or AAA categories feature ray tracing and a level of fidelity that's not possible to enjoy—for most people—without DLSS trickery.

"I think Alan Wake is the fidelity everything needs to hit," Smith Evergreen says. "Where you're like, I get it. I get your vibes. I can tell what's going on, and everything beyond that is gravy. Sure, would they prefer an immersive sim that's got insane spectacle and gorgeous, Arkane Lyon quality vistas? Of course they would like that. But is it necessary for what you came to an immersive sim for? I'm not sure that it is."
This ties into his belief that immersive sims shouldn't be aiming for AAA —it misunderstands the audience, specifically its size. It's just not enough to justify the cost of development.

"Like, you just have to put more money into them," he said, "make a bigger and bigger immersive sim. It's got to be AAA, and it's got to sit right alongside Ghost of Tsushima and GTA 6, and it's got to be a game that's big enough to capture the public's attention. But I think that might be a misread for the audience size of immersive sims."
This isn't something anybody is worrying about when it comes to Nightdive's Thief remaster , which won't be yassifying The City. Judging by what we've seen so far, it looks a lot like OG Thief.

"I'm super excited to see what they do," says Smith Evergreen. "Nightdive seems very trustworthy, very passionate. I like the projects they're choosing to remaster. So that's going to be awesome to see.

"In a way, I'll be able to play Thief again for the first time ever. I used to say that when I played Dishonored, that was the first time I ever played a Thief game. Because when you make a game, it's just a totally different experience than having played it. But I feel like enough time has passed since I played Thief: The Dark Project that playing a remaster will probably feel very fresh for me. So I'm excited about that."
We're still waiting for a Thief: The Dark Project Remastered release date, and Smith Evergreen is currently working on a project that "you'll hear about before too long".

items.summary: As part of its September update, Amazon Luna introduced a Remote Play feature that lets people play games toge

content.v: As part of its September update, Amazon Luna introduced a Remote Play feature that lets people play games together, even if they aren't in the same room.

If you haven't heard of it, Luna is Amazon's cloud gaming service for Prime subscribers that lets them access and play a catalog of games without the need for a console or PC. While some Luna games have had multiplayer features, you previously needed to be in the same room with others to play those titles.

Remote Play intends to solve that by letting Amazon Prime and Luna Premium subscribers invite up to seven others into their sessions. These other players won't need an Amazon Prime subscription to use Remote Play, although they will need to use Luna's website or TV app. Of course, you'll now be relying on the smooth internet connections of even more players to comfortably use Remote Play, but the same goes for similar features on PS5 or Nintendo Switch 2.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Amazon-Luna.png?w=636

To promote Remote Play, Amazon also released two new multiplayer-focused games today. One is a digital version of the board game King of Tokyo, while the other is It's Quiz Time: Guinness World Records, a competitive trivia game. Later in September, it will add the motion-controlled Bowling Mayhem and Pictionary-like Cranium Planet to the game catalog. Star Wars Outlaws and Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora were also added to the Luna Standard game lineup today, although those are single-player games.

This Remote Play update is one of the most substantial additions to Amazon Luna in some time, and it arrives in a month that hasn't been so great for cloud gaming. Last week, Xbox confirmed it will limit Game Pass Ultimate subscribers to just 15 hours of cloud gaming a month and make them pay extra for anything beyond that.
As Amazon Luna is included with Prime and just got this Remote Play feature, that makes it a little bit more alluring as a cloud gaming option.

content.v: The perfect place to spend my life with fleas and parasites.

The Binding of Isaac is perhaps the greatest roguelike ever made, or at the very least, I wouldn't argue with anyone who felt that way. So when developer and indie-game legend Edmund McMillen said that it was merely a basic roguelike to get his feet into the water before creating Mewgenics , my interest was certainly piqued. But 13 years after its announcement, Mewgenics arrived on PC earlier this year, and there was no way it could live up to the expectations after that long… Right? I'll let it already being my second-most played game ever on Steam behind Isaac do the talking.

Teaming up with The End Is Nigh co-developer Tyler Glaiel, Mewgenics is perhaps McMillen's strangest game to date – which is saying something. Here's the elevator pitch: you breed countless messed up cats in your home before sending them out to war in a roguelike tactical RPG, with classes, mechanics, and stats ripped right out of Dungeons & Dragons . It's messed up, it's hilarious, it's macabre, it's wildly inappropriate, and most of all it's just a phenomenal strategy game.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/10/gettyimages-2265564151-1789059057599.jpg
Pokémon cards will likely be used as currency following a global apocalypse, one venture capitalist has suggested.

Pete Levin, founder of VC firm Griffin Gaming Partners, said that the "global phenomenon" of Pokémon trading cards was perfect for use as a new form of currency, should the world's current economy collapse due to some terrible catastrophe.

Levin claims to manage more than $1.6 billion of gaming assets and, handily, also happens to be the owner of some 500,000 trading cards. Speaking to The Hollywood Reporter , he explained that Pokémon cards remained a hugely profitable asset for collectors — and suggested that their worth would also be kept, at least to some degree, even after the nukes fall.
"Pokémon is a global phenomenon," Levin said. "I'm absolutely convinced that if the world suffered an apocalypse tomorrow, the following day the global currency would be Pokémon cards.

"Pokémon cards are beating the S&P 500 by 3,000%," he continued. "Emanating from Japan, it really took hold around the world in the late '90s and early 2000s. It then had a zenith moment and then a nadir moment, and ever since then, it's been on a parabolic growth curve. And that really has driven the international market expansion for trading cards."
Despite being poised to personally profit if we all started to use Charizards instead of loose change, Levin also pointed to a few other reasons he was confident in his prophecy.

For one, card grading companies such as PSA now standardize card quality ratings and provide proof of authenticity. With these, cards have a clearly quantifiable value — even if the price attached to that is left for the market to decide. Then there's the so-called "kidult" phenomenon, where adults now make up around 30% of global toy sales — a figure that's on the rise.

"You've got a generation that has come of age that is nostalgic for these toys, for these vintage video games, for these trading cards and comic books, and they now have disposable income," Levin concluded. "So that's also been a huge tangible driver in the market."

So, never mind the claim that there's a greater than 10% chance AI will end civilization in the next 10 years . If you've got a couple of Pikachu Illustrators in your back pocket, you may still be able to buy a few tins of beans.

Word that we should all begin hoarding Pokémon cards for use after the apocalypse will likely not help ongoing issues with Pokémon card scarcity, which has prompted U.S. retailer Target to begin slicing open boxes to deter scalpers . In Japan, some releases are being limited to Japanese residents only , while facial recognition for adults and children has been rolled out in some locations to limit daily card purchases .

Pokémon cards have become a prime target for scalpers and thieves over the past few years due to their soaring popularity and the perceived value of rare cards. New card releases frequently sell out completely, and The Pokémon Company has appeared unable or unwilling to fully keep up with demand — despite a staggering 10 billion cards printed last year alone .

Looking to start your collection? We've also got a list of the 10 most expensive Pokémon cards of 2026 so far , and a first look at Mega Evolution's Delta Reign expansion , set to release in November this year.

items.title: 《战狗》即将登陆 Xbox 和 PS5，但还需要一段时间
items.summary: Wardogs, a new all-out warfare FPS game that has been blowing up on Steam, is officially coming to consoles...

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/10/wardogsthumb-1789046591629.png
Wardogs , a new all-out warfare FPS game that has been blowing up on Steam, is officially coming to consoles... but it'll be a while.

As part of its launch, the team behind Wardogs, Bulkhead, confirmed that it will bring the massive shooter to consoles. The game is slated to arrive on Xbox and PS5 in 2028, but is available in early access on Steam starting today. The game is launching for $39.99, with plans to increase the price as the game expands. The idea is to reward fans who support the game in its earliest stages and not charge them a full $60–$70 for an unfinished product.

“Wardogs is ambitious, rough around the edges and still has a long way to go, but that is exactly what Early Access should be,” said Joe Brammer, CEO at Bulkhead. “We’re putting the game in players’ hands, listening to what they tell us and taking the risks needed to turn it into something that can last. More than anything, we want people to get online, talk to each other and have the kind of fun in an FPS that we grew up having.”

All of this suggests that Wardogs might be targeting 2028 for its 1.0 release, as PlayStation is extremely selective about early access titles on its platform, unlike Xbox. Major titles like Subnautica 2 have had to skip PS5 during early access, but there have been exceptions. However, I wouldn't hold my breath for Wardogs being one of those exceptions at the moment.

It's also interesting that Bulkhead specifically confirmed PS5 as a release platform, since PlayStation 6 is heavily speculated to release next year. Whether the game will also have a native PS6 version remains to be seen, but would presumably be playable on the next-gen console with backward compatibility should that be a supported feature.

Wardogs is one of the most surprising titles of 2026, as it really only emerged over the summer as marketing began to ramp up. However, the response from players who participated in playtests has been glowing and indicates the shooter space may have another big contender going forward.
